value.rationale: The result distinguishes infinite divisibility (always true) from self-decomposability (loss/recovery at arbitrarily weak positive refractory occupation), an intrinsic Lévy-structure question for the natural stationary resetting distribution. The exact criterion and infinite interlacing show a nonmonotonic qualitative effect that cannot be read from the existing variance/kurtosis formulas. It is not an arbitrary finite slice; the limiting w down to 0 is the natural no-refractory regime, and both geometric families originate in the physical reset-contraction scales.
